title: Saving with the saved status picked asks no confirmation
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-NOCONF-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab, type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Change the Sell Price to 23.00.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Click the {Part-A} row.
  6. Click Inactive.
  7. Click Active again.
  8. Change the Sell Price to 24.00.
  9. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: the part saves and the window closes, with no confirmation window.
  • Step 9: again no confirmation window: the window closes and the row shows $24.00 on the Active tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R24, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.1 (Part Status in the dialog), 13 Oct copy.
